preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100000) representing the number of graph variants.

preconditions.expression:
all(line.strip() == '' or (len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split())) for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0 '))
preconditions.description: Each graph variant starts with a line containing integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 500000) and m (0 ≤ m ≤ 500000), followed by m lines of edge pairs (a_i, b_i) where 1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n. The graph is connected and has no multiple edges or self-loops.

preconditions.expression:
sum(int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and not line.startswith('0 ')) <= 500000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all variants is at most 500000.

preconditions.expression:
sum(int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and not line.startswith('0 ') and len(line.split()) == 2) <= 500000
preconditions.description: The sum of m over all variants is at most 500000.

postconditions.expression:
all(line.strip() in ['Yes', 'No'] or (line.strip() == 'Yes' and (len(stdout.split('
')) == 2 * (stdin.count('
') - 1) and all('No' not in out_part for out_part in stdout.split('
') if out_part.strip() == 'Yes'))) for line in stdout.split('
'))
postconditions.description: For each graph variant, output is either 'No' or 'Yes' followed by a valid solution (c and c distinct vertex indices) if one exists.

postconditions.expression:
all((out_part.strip() == 'No') or (out_part.strip() == 'Yes' and (len(out_part.split()) == 1 and int(out_part.split()[0]) == c) and (next_line.strip() == '' or (len(next_line.split()) == c and all(1 <= int(v) <= n for v in next_line.split())))) for out_part, next_line in zip(stdout.split('
'), [''] + stdout.split('
')[:-1]))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the next line contains an integer c (1 < c < n) and c distinct vertex indices (1 ≤ v ≤ n).

postconditions.expression:
all((out_part.strip() == 'No') or (out_part.strip() == 'Yes' and (lambda S: all((deg_v - sum(1 for (u, v) in edges if u == v or v == u)) % 3 == deg_v % 3 for v in remaining_vertices))(set(next_line.split())) for out_part, next_line in zip(stdout.split('
'), [''] + stdout.split('
')[:-1])) if out_part.strip() == 'Yes' else True)
postconditions.description: For a 'Yes' answer, the stolen vertices S must satisfy that for every remaining vertex v, its degree modulo 3 in the original graph equals its degree modulo 3 after removing S and all edges incident to S. Here, deg_v is the original degree of v, and edges are the original edges of the graph.
